title: Implementation Plan task
description: One agent-buildable task: one pass of work. Mirrors Task in src/types.ts.

repo.description: A repo under `repos` in the project config; validation checks it is one.

story.description: The user story it serves, a key the TaskSet (plan/taskset.yaml) declares. Its feature, epic and lane follow from it, and the lane's repo must be the task's repo.

placeholder_for.description: Written by the Milestones step: the task is built before these tasks, against a placeholder its description and acceptance spell out. They are not in its blocked_by; the task that `wires` it replaces the placeholder.

wires.description: Written by the Milestones step: this follow-up task replaces these tasks' placeholders with the real dependency. It is blocked_by each of them and every task in their placeholder_for.

agent.description: Pins the task to one agent.

role.description: Which of the agent's configured models runs the task, build when absent. Design is creative work (art, animation).

summary.description: What the last pass that changed the task's state did, for the dependency map. Written by the loop.

kept.description: The branch this attempt's work is kept on, for the next attempt to finish: it passed its own gate, but main changed under it.
